method: Structured JSON from the Gemini API, instructed by docs/PROJECT_VISION.md@main blob 8cc39ea9d27d. Every cited URL was fetched; dead links and pages that never mention the character were removed, and feats, results, conditions and campaign tags that lost their source were moved to unknowns. All records provisional.

characters.summary: Proximo is an aging former gladiator turned ruthless lanista and trainer. In his prime he was a legendary fighter granted his freedom, but in his later years, he relies on wits, experience, and running his gladiatorial troupe.
limitations: Aged physical condition limiting endurance compared to younger fighters

sources.supports: Proximo background as a former champion gladiator turned trainer and his eventual death protecting Maximus.

notableResults.note: Killed while fighting off multiple armed guards to aid Maximus's escape.

unknowns: Exact record of his undefeated streak in his prime outside of broad mentions.

characters.summary: Rama is an elite Indonesian police officer highly skilled in Pencak Silat. He combines brutal close-quarters combat, lethal striking, and improvised weapon use to defeat wave after wave of armed criminals.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to firearms and ranged weapons
Prone to exhaustion after prolonged continuous combat
limitations: Dependent on physical stamina and close-range engagement

sources.supports: Rama's background as an elite tactical officer skilled in Pencak Silat battling through a criminal-infested tenement.

notableResults.note: Fought alongside his brother Andi against the exceptionally lethal assassin, ultimately securing a victory using a broken fluorescent light bulb.

unknowns: Exact tactical training history outside of standard police mobile brigade unit credentials.

characters.summary: Rick O'Connell is a rugged adventurer, former French Foreign Legionnaire, and US Army soldier. He relies on dual-wielded firearms, explosives, and fierce hand-to-hand resourcefulness against supernatural threats.
weaknesses: Mortal human vulnerabilities against supernatural entities without specific counter-artifacts
mobility: Standard human mobility with proficient climbing and riding
limitations: Limited to standard mortal physical limits and ammunition supply

sources.supports: Rick O'Connell's military background, weaponry expertise, and encounters with Imhotep.

notableResults.note: Defeated the mummified high priest after Imhotep was rendered mortal by the Book of Amun-Ra.

campaignTags.claim: Uses specialized explosives, firearms, and antiquities

unknowns: Exact details of his exploits during the French Foreign Legion.

characters.summary: Robert the Bruce is a medieval Scottish monarch and guerrilla warfare tactician. He leads forces using armored cavalry charges, heavy broadswords, and terrain-based ambushes against superior numbers.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to outnumbering forces and heavy archer volleys without defensive positioning
mobility: Standard human movement in heavy armor
limitations: Restricted by medieval weapon ranges and armor weight

sources.supports: Robert the Bruce's leadership in the Scottish Wars of Independence and tactical combat feats.

notableResults.citation: Outlaw King (2018) Battle of Loudoun Hill
notableResults.note: Defeated a heavily armored English force using prepared defensive trenches and wetland terrain.

campaignTags.claim: Fights effectively while riding a warhorse in medieval cavalry combat

unknowns: Exact historical versus cinematic discrepancies in combat portrayals.

characters.summary: Robin of Locksley is an expert crusader-turned-outlaw archer. He combines exceptional longbow marksmanship, stealth tactics, and guerrilla warfare to harass the Sheriff of Nottingham's forces.
weaknesses: Limited close-combat effectiveness when cornered without distance
mobility: Standard human running and forest traversal
limitations: Ammunition dependent on quiver capacity for archery

sources.supports: Robin's expertise with the longbow, quarterstaff combat, and leading an outlaw rebellion.

notableResults.citation: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves (1991) climax
notableResults.note: Defeated the Sheriff in a sword duel during the rescue of hostages.

campaignTags.claim: Executes guerrilla ambushes and hides within Sherwood Forest

unknowns: Exact range limits of his longbow marksmanship under adverse weather.

characters.summary: Roper is an American martial artist and veteran gambler who combines traditional boxing with fierce martial arts striking. He fights with high mobility, flashy kicks, and resilient physical toughness.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to armed opponents and specialized martial arts masters when outnumbered
limitations: Strictly relies on unarmed physical strikes

sources.supports: Roper's participation in Han's tournament and his martial arts combat style blending boxing and karate.

notableResults.note: Defeated Han's massive bodyguard in hand-to-hand combat.

unknowns: Complete competitive tournament history prior to the island invitation.

characters.summary: Sarah Connor is a hardened survivalist and guerrilla militant. Transformed into an uncompromising warrior, she utilizes assault rifles, shotguns, explosives, and ruthless tactical planning to hunt cybernetic threats.
limitations: Limited by human physical endurance and ammunition limits

sources.supports: Sarah Connor's transformation into a militant survivalist skilled in heavy weaponry and tactical combat against machines.

notableResults.citation: Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) steel mill sequence
notableResults.note: Overwhelmed by the liquid metal terminator until the T-800 intervened, though she assisted in the final destruction.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes advanced military firearms, pipe bombs, and tactical gear

unknowns: Exact parameters of all weapons stockpiles accumulated across safe houses.

characters.summary: The Sheriff of Nottingham is a corrupt, tyrannical nobleman who fights with ruthless cruelty, utilizing broadsword combat, armored guards, and ruthless political execution.

mechanisms: Full plate and chain mail armor

weaknesses: Arrogance and overconfidence in single combat
mobility: Standard human movement in heavy armor
limitations: Relies heavily on brute force and armored protection rather than superior agility

sources.supports: The Sheriff's role as the primary antagonist, wielding a broadsword and commanding Nottingham guards.

notableResults.citation: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves (1991) climax
notableResults.note: Defeated and killed by Robin in the castle chapel duel.

unknowns: Extent of his personal combat training outside of noble knightly standards.

characters.summary: Sheriff Will Teasle is a small-town police chief and decorated Korean War veteran. He leads local law enforcement in manhunts using standard firearms, vehicles, and tactical sweeps.
weaknesses: Stubborn pride and underestimation of asymmetric guerrilla warfare veterans
limitations: Outmatched by specialized Green Beret guerrilla tactics in wilderness environments

sources.supports: Sheriff Teasle's military background as a Green Beret veteran and his pursuit of John Rambo.

notableResults.note: Badly wounded in a final shootout at the police station after Rambo infiltrated the town.

unknowns: Exact combat achievements during his service in the Korean War.

characters.summary: Solomon Lane is a former MI6 officer turned cold, calculating mastermind of the Syndicate. He employs advanced tech espionage, tactical operatives, firearms, and strategic planning to eliminate rivals.
weaknesses: Over-reliance on complex contingencies that can be circumvented by adaptive agents
limitations: Vulnerable to direct physical confrontation when isolated from his network

sources.supports: Solomon Lane's background as leader of the Syndicate, utilizing high-tech operations and tactical combat.

notableResults.note: Trapped in a pressurized glass cell and captured by Ethan Hunt.

campaignTags.claim: Employs encrypted communications, specialized explosives, and tactical weaponry

unknowns: Full extent of his global assets prior to IMF intervention.
